summary: Phase 2 (Invoices + Money Receipts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASSED including invoice CRUD, monotonic INV-XXXXXX numbering, auto-linked sale row with source='invoice', invoice_id, invoice_no matching, PDF upload to object storage, media-token flow (200/403/401), receipts CRUD with all payment_modes/source_types, source_label resolution when source_type='invoice', validation errors, delete-cascade of linked sale, admin-only delete guards for both invoices & receipts, stats/sales-today.by_source split, and regression on 8 existing endpoints. Frontend: /invoices, /receipts and /more all render for admin; new-invoice editor shows dynamic Add/remove rows, live per-row Amount and Grand total math; new-receipt editor exposes all 3 payment-mode and 4 source-type segmented controls; More menu shows both 'Invoices' and 'Money receipts' rows. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this phase (reportlab only; expo-av not used here).
action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not blocking): In InvoiceEditor, mobile is validated for min 6 digits on the frontend but the backend accepts any string; consider making backend also validate mobile length to keep parity.
OPTIONAL: Receipt editor requires amount > 0 in UI, but backend allows amount >= 0. Align both if 0-amount receipts should not be allowed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2673 lines — consider splitting invoice/receipt/PDF module into a separate file for maintainability.
Invoice PDF build is synchronous inside async endpoint (reportlab is CPU-bound). For heavy loads consider run_in_threadpool for _build_document_pdf like put_object already does.
receipts.notes concat uses '\n' but code has a bug-free implementation: footer_notes=(body.notes or '') + (f'\nPayment mode: {mode.upper()}') — safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all screens load, testIDs present, live math correct, segments render)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test invoices (TEST_Ravi Sharma, TEST_RcptSrc) and 1 test receipt during testing — all deleted via /api/invoices DELETE and /api/receipts DELETE at the end. Verified via admin listing after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs pytest via `pytest backend/tests/test_invoices_receipts.py -o addopts=''` to bypass xdist (class-level attrs used to share state across ordered tests). Object storage via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is live and PDF bytes verified (start with %PDF). Test data is prefixed 'TEST_' for easy cleanup.
